admission.justification: Future start/attach, abandon or task publication changes must keep native task and parent stages coherent rather than restoring a redundant agent status write or a second session stage store. Current test sources pin restart promotion, parent preflight, two-document rollback and exact cross-root mirrors; no fresh execution is asserted.

applicability: Native worktree start/attach and abandon publication of readable, in-place canonical task documents and their admitted parent row.
conditions: Start promotes planning or an admitted abandoned successor to inProgress; attaching retains document stage and exact existing facts make publication idempotent.
Task-stage candidates retain their exact source snapshots and use the existing rollback-safe JSON/Markdown batch writer; parent stage comes from that same native document stage.
Abandon preflights task/parent linkage before terminal mutation, revalidates source before publication, and composes task/parent stage with contract publication under its existing terminal guard.
Finalize, reopen and explicit task corrections retain their existing authority; completed documents are not reopened by ordinary start.
exclusions: An absent task source does not authorize inventing a document, and malformed/ambiguous parent linkage is not silently repaired.
Rollback of task-source/contract publication does not promise restoration of already-reclaimed worktrees or all earlier bootstrap side effects.
Disposable projection effects remain separately reported; their failure is not another task-stage authority.
Proof facets describe current test assertions read from A011, not a fresh Curator execution or independent acceptance.
